articles.title: US officials visit Palestinian village after settler attacks on diplomats
EU 'strongly condemns' settler attack on delegation in West Bank
articles.summary: The European Union said Sunday that it "strongly condemns" an attack the previous day by a group of Israeli settlers on visiting European diplomats in the occupied West Bank. "The EU strongly condemns the latest attacks by violent settlers in the West Bank, including on European diplomats," the foreign service said in a communique. The communique also urged "full accountability as well as effective measures to prevent continued acts of violence and violent harassment against Palestinians…

articles.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians as military conducts raid in occupied West Bank
articles.summary: Here are the latest developments in the occupied West Bank on Sunday, according to Palestinian news agency Wafa: Nablus: Israeli settlers attacked olive harvesters in Bazariya, Beita, Qusra, Qabalan, Burqa and Madama, assaulting farmers and stealing olives and harvesting equipment, Palestinian security sources said. Beita: Israeli settlers cut electricity to Muntaser Hamayel’s home on the town’s outskirts by severing the power pole supplying it, Palestinian security sources said. Masafer Yatta…
